name: Luna Gateway Traffic Probe
description: Optional platform component that collects Gateway API traffic windows and reports settled usage to Luna DevOps billing.

values.label: Luna DevOps API base URL
values.description: Public or cluster-reachable Luna DevOps API endpoint used by the probe to report traffic windows.

values.label: Traefik metrics URL
values.description: Optional Prometheus metrics endpoint reachable from the probe Pod. Leave blank to use http://traefik.<Gateway namespace>.svc.cluster.local:9100/metrics.
